# Passport vectors

`examples/` and `negative/` are verbatim copies of SWCraft's passport vectors (now under
`packages/tools/tests/fixtures/contracts/model-passport/`), taken at commit `256d57a8f` of the branch `phase47-2-tiers-as-gates`, the same commit
`swcraft_specimens/passport_schema/model_passport.schema.json` was first vendored from. The vectors
are byte-identical to those of SWCraft's tag `v0.21.0`, the pinned release; the schema differs
from that tag's in two `description` annotations, so it was re-vendored from it (SPEC § 20).

`small.swcraft-passport.json` is the output of `swcraft passport --project <tree>/swcraft.yaml`
(SWCraft's 47.2 worktree at `f48b2476f`, whose `passport.py` and schema equal those of
`256d57a8f`; it reported `swcraft 0.19.1`; 0.19.2 ships the same `passport.py` and schema), run once as an external program on the tree of the
`small` preset generated by this repository (project tree SHA-256
`683682a9bab4865b3ae79c7568d9227c4defb86bac9b3193671ae488c6c5e0fd`). It is an oracle output
recorded as a fixture: `tests/test_passport_pass.py` holds the specimen generator's pass equal to it.

`minimal.swcraft-passport.json`, `topology.swcraft-passport.json` and
`large-scale-topology.swcraft-passport.json` are the outputs of the same command (SWCraft's 47.2
worktree at `cde976a2cb889b8779715c31a2c1b0b741e158e2`, whose `passport.py` and schema equal
those of `256d57a8f`: `git diff --stat 256d57a8f HEAD` over the two files was empty; it reports
`swcraft 0.19.1`), run once each, with `--output`, on the trees of the three specimen presets
under `swcraft_specimens/presets/specimens/` generated by this repository with `python -m swcraft_specimens generate`
(project tree SHA-256 `fc36d0a9ac8a1fff27a356978dea19ffcd99221c1d1d02b4424234aac092742c`,
`a57b44ea2c34658e7ecc80a37aee879efd4958bef03a426fa049fef30799f4d2` and
`bbe049cf45682cd15df93ca44bb56d19dca6ad0900931250b5a80d30a242866f`, then the goldens of
`tests/test_specimen_fixtures.py`). That test holds the specimen generator's pass equal to each, and every
leaf each preset states met by it.

A later change then shortened the specimen names: the index is as wide as
the kind's count and the hardware stems have two letters. The three presets state every identifier
leaf (`large-scale-topology` states its met layers at the values of its recording), so their
elements were renamed and every length kept: their trees moved to
`05ea8dfc4972acc4107ab40bce6ce3c3df15cba293a80188213d0ea62db238ea`,
`2b3751a8c8a7fb50ddcedc9a6fafcedbd61fa7f79dc844271646eb4d6bb68ea9` and
`e997bed4ace6b24e8f5a0dd3890da9fe885610c288e756fb53633687b102ae87`, their recordings did not (the
test pins the recordings' file digests and holds the pass over the new trees equal to them).

`shapes.swcraft-passport.json`, `chain-empty.swcraft-passport.json` and
`large-scale-shapes.swcraft-passport.json` (recorded for the remaining shapes) are
the outputs of `swcraft passport --project <tree>/swcraft.yaml --output <file>` of a SWCraft
0.19.2 release install (it reports `swcraft 0.19.2`; then the pinned release, SPEC § 15), run once
each as an external program on the trees of the three specimen presets of the same names under
`swcraft_specimens/presets/specimens/`, generated by this repository with `python -m swcraft_specimens generate`
(project tree SHA-256 `067f187a8ff58ece1b2a2c8f44accb63dbe293b7215c0f317e6a6386aa13b57c`,
`b0de3c3dccbd138dd09743e691e077d70ee9eba0f883154ffccd2d047a798d9c` and
`b3087093efbdbfc00a9999eabe2cc521ac449fc47b3bea7fc7b66859acd0cad7`, the goldens of
`tests/test_specimen_fixtures.py`). Before recording, the same release's `check-model --format
json` reported no finding on each tree, `check-model --warnings-as-errors` exited 0 and
`validate` passed. The presets are synthetic: `shapes` states every leaf the slice built off its
neutral value, `chain-empty` leaves the deepest composition empty, and `large-scale-shapes` holds
the plan's rounded figures at a large synthetic scale.

A later change then made every specimen write data accesses
(each component's `R1` reads every data element of its sender-receiver require ports and
writes every data element of its sender-receiver provide ports) and ported the per-core RAM
(memory j accessible from core j mod cores alone, threshold 0.8, budgets on the first memory
of each component's core, each memory sized for its budgets). That moved all six trees and all six
sidecars once, with no re-recording. The accesses
each tree gains: `minimal` 2, `topology` 360, `large-scale-topology` 3,000, `shapes` 300,
`chain-empty` 2, `large-scale-shapes` 2,750. The memories change only where there are any:
`shapes` and `topology` each have two, now one core each, size 4,096 bytes and threshold 0.8
(before: every core, 1,048,576 bytes, 0.7), with every budget 0 because a fixture has no task.

`848fdd0a767cb41a43f14133ed3b134fecf59b4f4b5a6dd51e3a0b14350d00c7`,
`38f7eb419a72492de4a6575010831f0d3d24956c0f425a272f2ee5b16168a01f`,
`49cb4ea1864533c392803befab2d4a0ff7ae6ccd97eded3a63ca8e2ec7973e51`,

`9f75039eb27ae11453a12df9a547c281606ecdeae645eca171f648970de2685c`.

Three things did not move. **No recording:** the passport pass reads no access, budget or
reachability, so the six recordings above are unchanged and `tests/test_specimen_fixtures.py`
still pins their file digests and holds the pass over each new tree equal to its recording.
**No WATERS digest:** both rules are a specimen's only (`tests/test_production_preset_golden.py` unchanged
and green). **No canonical layout:** layouts read no access and no hardware
(`tests/fixtures/layout/canonical.json` unchanged).

The pin move to SWCraft 0.21.0 (SPEC § 20, 2026-11-03) moved all six trees and all six sidecars
once more, through each manifest's `toolchain_version` and each sidecar's `swcraft_version`, with
no re-recording: the passport pass reads neither. The tree digests moved, in the order of the
table above, to `1ac7ebd8…3068`, `81152139…adb4`, `55fb32c2…0103`, `9babf81d…06f0`,
`8c64c481…96f6` and `6f517175…108e`, and the sidecar digests to `2fad838e…fe9e`, `9294e891…6eab`,
`8ca9221c…885c`, `36c63ce7…128c`, `e2db4947…926c` and `e02b1f6f…0348` (the full values are the
goldens of `tests/test_specimen_fixtures.py`).

SPEC § 21 (2026-11-04) removed the pin: a manifest names the SWCraft release found at run time,
and the goldens are taken with none found (`tests/conftest.py`), so each manifest has no
`toolchain_version` and each sidecar's `swcraft_version` is `null`; the generator version moved to
0.2.0 in the same change. All six trees and all six sidecars moved once more, again with no
re-recording. The tree digests moved, in the order of the table above, to `5afffc52…b56e`,
`9517cc6f…f897`, `b581eb79…715e`, `8ed094f6…a0cb`, `87b6f8bd…d538` and `683c1095…4e56`, and the
sidecar digests to `03f1e46d…ad97`, `96957071…4e6a`, `4701b8a3…2f69`, `21ed1ed3…10ce`,
`4826ef19…a2bf` and `e7c6465e…5496`.

On 2026-11-13 `large-scale-topology`'s preset took new invented figures, rounded at a large
synthetic scale (75 components, 500 interfaces, 1,400 connectors, 500 implementation types; the
largest component 430 ports, 290 unconnected and 140 on one, the heaviest interface 600), and
`large-scale-topology.swcraft-passport.json` was re-recorded: `swcraft passport
--project <tree>/swcraft.yaml --output <file>` of SWCraft 0.23.0 (`.venv` of the work repository),
run once on the tree `python -m swcraft_specimens generate large-scale-topology` wrote (project tree
SHA-256 `4eb1142d8022919394f5ba0f4aec875536200060457888a5730643faa4548264`). That release writes
`contract_version` `12.7.0`; the recording carries the preset's `12.0.0` in that one field, as every
other recording here does, and is otherwise the command's output byte for byte. Its old recording
differed from it in the changed figures and that field alone.

On 2026-11-13 the two large fixtures were renamed, values unchanged: their presets and recordings
are `large-scale-topology` and `large-scale-shapes` (the text above uses the new names throughout),
and the preset comments that described where their scale came from were reduced to "a large
synthetic scale". The recordings' bytes did not move; a digest that names a preset file's bytes
moved with its comment.
